statement: The record confirms Saturday at 08:30 at Fairview Motors for brake pads and discs, but it lists the sold blue Vauxhall, so I’ll book it for the grey Honda.
judge_text:
WRONG

"it lists the sold blue Vauxhall" — the answer asserts the car on the record is wrong (sold in June) and substitutes the grey Honda.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
